subject: Mobile Development
title: Apple's Search Ads Business
description: A quick win: understand Apple's Search Ads Business.

hook.text: You search for a meditation app. The top result is an ad. Apple sold that spot.

buildup.text: Apple Search Ads let developers pay to appear at the top of App Store searches.

discovery.text: This advertising business generates billions annually and is growing fast.

twist.text: Critics say Apple profits twice: once from the 30% cut, and again from selling search ads.

climax.text: Apple's ad business creates a conflict: it profits when organic discovery is harder.

punchline.text: The store sells apps — and ads for apps.

quiz.question: How do Apple Search Ads work?
options: Developers pay to appear at the top of search results
